article.title: Broad international support for Cuba at the United Nations General Assembly
article.author: Editor
article.content: The United Nations General Assembly has once again approved the resolution calling for an end to the economic, commercial, and financial blockade imposed by the United States against Cuba. The post Broad international support for Cuba at the United Nations General Assembly appeared first on MR Online .
